text.heading: Describe it, get a

image.title: Image to 3D
image.heading: Turn a photo or sketch into a
image.subtitle: One clear photo on a plain background works best. Add up to four views for Meshy and Rodin, or draw a sketch and let Hunyuan build it.
image.placeholder: Add a photo of the object, or draw a sketch, then generate.

retexture.title: Retexture
retexture.heading: Give any model a
retexture.subtitle: Pick a model from your library or upload a GLB, then describe the look or drop in a reference image. The geometry stays, the surface changes.
retexture.placeholder: Describe the new look, for example weathered copper with green patina

rig.title: Rig and animate
rig.heading: Make a character
rig.subtitle: Meshy adds a skeleton to a humanoid model and, if you want, a default animation. You get GLB and FBX back, ready for a game engine.
rig.placeholder: Pick a humanoid model from your library or upload a GLB, set its height, then apply.

mesh.title: Mesh tools
mesh.heading: Clean up a mesh for
mesh.subtitle: Remesh to a polygon budget with baked textures, split a model into parts, or rebuild its topology as clean quads.
mesh.placeholder: Pick a model from your library or upload a GLB, choose a tool, then apply.
